title: Pairwise Judging versus Voting for Language Model Answer Selection: Finite-Pool Theory and an Empirical Audit
description: OR-Select v1.1.0: code, public stored runs, generated tables, revised manuscript and online supplement accompanying Pairwise Judging versus Voting for Language Model Answer Selection: Finite-Pool Theory and an Empirical Audit. Stored judgments support offline selector replay where present. Experimental records and selection behavior are unchanged. GPQA Diamond files embed password-gated question text and are not included; the released workflow can generate new runs with authorized benchmark access, not recreate the original stochastic outputs. This release does not overwrite the v1.0.0 archive.
